customSections.label: Make-Up Days & Weather Changes
customSections.content: RCPS publishes the order it will use if weather or another closure requires additional instructional time.

groups.label: Published make-up order
items: The first five missed days use banked days.
The sixth missed day uses January 3, the seventh uses February 7, and the eighth uses March 13.
The ninth missed day is marked “Not Required.” For 10 or more missed days, RCPS may add time to the school day.

groups.label: Before making plans
items: Check RCPS announcements before treating January 3, February 7, or March 13 as a guaranteed day off.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this the official RCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: MySchoolDates is an independent reference based on the calendar page and PDF published by Roanoke County Public Schools. The current 2027–28 PDF remains labeled DRAFT — SUBJECT TO CHANGE, so RCPS is the source of record for revisions.

calendarFaqs.q: How do RCPS make-up days work in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: RCPS uses banked days for the first five missed days. The published order then uses January 3 for the sixth day, February 7 for the seventh, and March 13 for the eighth. For 10 or more missed days, RCPS may add time to the school day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are RCPS teacher workdays in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Teacher workdays are August 2–6 and August 9–11, 2027, before students begin. The calendar also lists October 11, January 3, March 10, and May 26 as teacher workdays; January 3 may be converted under the make-up schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do students leave on RCPS early-dismissal days?
calendarFaqs.a: On districtwide three-hour early-dismissal days, elementary schools dismiss at 11:25 a.m. and secondary schools at 12:25 p.m. On May 23–24, early dismissal applies only to secondary students, at 12:25 p.m.

calendarFaqs.q: When do RCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028. Monday, January 3 is a teacher workday and may be converted if RCPS needs its sixth make-up day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are March 14–15 virtual-learning days for all RCPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official calendar lists March 14–15, 2028 as virtual-learning days for high school students only.

calendarFaqs.q: When are RCPS graduation ceremonies in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: RCPS lists graduation ceremonies on May 23–24, 2028, at 2:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m. Secondary students dismiss at 12:25 p.m. on both days; families should confirm each school’s ceremony assignment.
